Quantum 1.8.0 was certified on 2026-07-20. It pins **nucleus v1.4.0**, **quark v1.3.3** and **orbit v1.4.4**.

A minor release of the suite after Quantum 1.7.2: nucleus goes from v1.3.3 to v1.4.0 (minor), quark goes from v1.3.2 to v1.3.3 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.4.3 to v1.4.4 (patch).
